g.text: UML 2.5 COMPONENT DIAGRAM: PATIENT HEALTH RECORD CONSENT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (PHRCMS)
Lab 3 Architectural Specification & Component Modelling | Scenario 13 (Healthcare & Telemedicine) | Student: Rohan M (PES1UG24CS381) | Course: UE24CS341A
SUBSYSTEM: CLIENT PRESENTATION TIER (USER TOUCHPOINTS & CHANNELS)
• Grants time-bounded access to verified doctors with expiry (FR-001)
• Instantly revokes active consent before scheduled expiration (FR-002)
• Real-time audit visibility into active/expired consent registry (FR-003)
• Requests access to diagnostic records under patient consent (FR-004)
• Displays time-bounded session timer and diagnostic health history
• Auto-terminates clinical viewing immediately upon consent expiration
• Registers clinic doctors and validates medical registration credentials
• Monitors hospital compliance logs and audit trail integrity
SUBSYSTEM: SECURE EDGE & API GATEWAY LAYER (TLS 1.3 PERIMETER & AUTHENTICATION GUARD)
API Gateway, Reverse Proxy & OAuth2 / OIDC Auth Guard Component
Responsibilities: TLS 1.3 Termination, Reverse Proxy Routing, OAuth2 JWT Bearer Validation, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Rate Limiting & DDoS Guard
SUBSYSTEM: CORE APPLICATION & DOMAIN SERVICES TIER (BUSINESS LOGIC, PDP/PEP & AUDIT TRAIL)
Core Domain: Manages consent grant, instant revoke & query lifecycle
• IDoctorVerificationCheck (queries doctor verified flag before grant)
• IAuditPublisher (publishes grant & revoke events to audit trail)
Zero-Trust Policy Enforcement Point & Policy Decision Point
• IAuditPublisher (logs all ALLOW and DENY attempts to audit)
Core Domain: Medical Diagnostics & FHIR Records
Core Domain: Admin Doctor Credential & Status
Responsibilities: Permanently logs all consent grant, revoke, doctor record access, and verification events. Employs cryptographic SHA-256 hash chaining to ensure tamper-evident non-repudiation.
SUBSYSTEM: DATA PERSISTENCE & SECURE STORAGE TIER (ACID COMPLIANCE, IN-MEMORY CACHE & IMMUTABLE LEDGER)
• Consents: id, patient_id, doctor_id, records, expiry, status
Security: AES-256 Tablespace Encryption & Row-Level Security
• Sub-5ms Read Latency ensures NFR-002 (< 500ms constraint)
Sync: Event-driven write-through & instant cache invalidation
Engine: AWS S3 Object Store / MinIO Encrypted Volume
• Diagnostic Health Records: FHIR JSON, DICOM, Lab Reports
• Envelope Encryption: AWS KMS Customer Managed Keys (CMK)
• Access Control: Decryption key delivered ONLY upon PEP pass
Security: Compliant with HIPAA Security Rule & DISHA
Engine: WORM (Write Once Read Many) Ledger [NFR-001]
• Event Chain: Previous Hash, Event Payload, SHA-256 Hash
• Strict Immutable Access: Revoked DB update/delete privileges
Audit Compliance: Permanent forensic auditability for inspections
